## FREE - AI YouTube Video Publisher

### How it works

This workflow manually publishes a video to YouTube from a provided source URL. It collects the video URL and topic, uses OpenAI to generate YouTube-ready metadata, parses the AI output, downloads the video file, and uploads it to YouTube with the generated metadata.

### Setup steps

- Configure OpenAI credentials for the metadata generation node.
- Configure YouTube OAuth credentials with permission to upload videos.
- Update the Enter Video Details node with a valid source_url and topic before running the workflow.
- Ensure the source_url points to a downloadable video file that n8n can access.

### Customization

Adjust the OpenAI prompt or parsing code to change the title, description, tags, category, privacy status, or other YouTube metadata.

## Start and enter details

Manual trigger and initial field setup for the video source URL and topic that drive the rest of the workflow.

## Generate and parse metadata

Uses OpenAI to create YouTube metadata from the provided topic, then runs code to structure the AI response for downstream upload.

## Download and upload video

Downloads the video file from the configured source URL and publishes it to YouTube using the prepared metadata.

=You are a YouTube content optimization assistant.

Create an optimized YouTube title and description for the following video.

Video topic:
{{ $json.topic }}

Requirements:

TITLE:
- Maximum 70 characters
- Clear and engaging
- Do not use clickbait
- Do not invent facts

DESCRIPTION:
- 2-4 short sentences
- Clearly describe the video based only on the provided topic
- Add exactly 3 relevant hashtags at the end
- Do not invent facts

Use the same language as the provided topic.

Return ONLY valid JSON in exactly this format:

{
  "title": "Video title",
  "description": "Video description\n\n#hashtag1 #hashtag2 #hashtag3"
}
